'''Demmi Wot''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I know an ex-Ragtag who helps me with this kind of thing. His name is Demmi Wot.|[[Finn Shallo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CSV" />}}
Demmi Wot used to be a member of the [[Ragtags]], a group of low-life thugs. However, he finally left the gang because he did not tolerate vandalism and violence. At some point, he worked with the [[Corellia Times]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Finn Shallo]] and provided him information about the Corellian criminal groups.<ref name="SWG:CSV" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Demmi Wot and Finn Shallo accepted to help a spacer working for [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]]. Thanks to Wot, the spacer was able to discover that the Ragtags were responsible for vandalism in the [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Starport]].<ref name="SWG:CSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Demmi Wot was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]]'' [[Star Wars Galaxies]], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CSV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Demmi Wot was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> He was part of questline that featured the Rogue CorSec plot against the Diktat.<ref name="SWG:CSV" /> This story arc was later slightly revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]," on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> as the questline was integrated into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:CSV" />
